FX-SNOW-001.says: The settings as they start: colour #ffffff, density 50, spacing 32, size 6, scene depth 50, speed 2, wind 0.5, wiggle 3 every 48 frames, seed 0, opacity 100, on the night solid. The frame is smaller than one near cell, so it sees a few flakes, falling and drifting a little right between frame 0 and frame 4.

FX-SNOW-002.says: Spacing 6, size 3: flakes of all three planes across the frame, the far ones smaller, falling two pixels a frame, the far ones slower.

FX-SNOW-003.says: Spacing 6, size 3, density 0: no cell holds a flake, so the solid is untouched at every frame.

FX-SNOW-004.says: Spacing 6, size 3, density 100: every cell holds a flake, FX-SNOW-002's among them in the same places, so every pixel is at least as snowy as there.

FX-SNOW-005.says: Spacing 6, size 3, opacity 50: FX-SNOW-002's flakes at half their strength.

FX-SNOW-006.says: Spacing 6, size 3, opacity 0: the solid, untouched.

FX-SNOW-007.says: Spacing 6, size 0: flakes of no size give no light; the solid, untouched at every frame.

FX-SNOW-008.says: Spacing 6, size 3, scene depth 0: the three planes all at the near scale, each its own flakes.

FX-SNOW-009.says: Spacing 6, size 3, scene depth 100: the far plane at a third of the near scale, its flakes a pixel wide at most and close together.

FX-SNOW-010.says: Spacing 6, size 3, scene depth 0, no wind and no wiggle, speed 1: every plane falls straight down one pixel a frame, so frame 1 is frame 0 moved one pixel down, and frame 4 four.

FX-SNOW-011.says: Spacing 6, size 3, scene depth 0, no wiggle, speed 0, wind -1: the snow blown left one pixel a frame, so frame 2 is frame 0 moved two pixels left.

FX-SNOW-012.says: Spacing 6, size 3, scene depth 0, speed 0, no wind, wiggle 2 every 4 frames: the flakes sway where they hang, so frame 2 differs and frame 4, one whole sway later, is frame 0.

FX-SNOW-013.says: Spacing 6, size 3, still: no fall, no wind, no wiggle, so frame 4 is frame 0.

FX-SNOW-014.says: Spacing 6, size 3, seed 7: flakes of their own.

FX-SNOW-015.says: Spacing 6, size 3, seed 7.9, which counts as 7: FX-SNOW-014.

FX-SNOW-016.says: Spacing 6, size 3, colour a pale blue #a0c8ff written in capitals, #A0C8FF: FX-SNOW-002's flakes at the same strengths, in the blue.

FX-SNOW-017.says: Spacing 6, size 3, opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the solid, frame 2 opacity 50 and frame 4 opacity 100.

FX-SNOW-018.says: Spacing 6, size 3, density keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 0 is the solid; frame 2 would pass 100, is held at 100, and is density 100 at frame 2.

FX-SNOW-019.says: FX-SNOW-002 moved three pixels right: the planes are the drawing's own, so the snow moves with it, and the three columns left bare stay empty.

FX-SNOW-020.says: FX-SNOW-002 on Noise's card: the same flakes, each pixel that shows mixed toward the snow as much as on the solid, the soft edge at its own half covering, and the empty column and row stay empty.

FX-SNOW-021.says: Density 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-022.says: Spacing 1, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-023.says: Size 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-024.says: Scene depth -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-025.says: Wind -1001, past -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-026.says: Wiggle 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-027.says: Period 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-028.says: A colour written "#fffff", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SNOW-029.says: Opacity keyed to 150 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
